# ocost-splitter

Split the unattributed cost of a shared Kubernetes cluster across the namespaces that share it.

## What it does

Reads OpenCost allocation data and applies one of four split methods to the shared cost pool:
- Proportional: weighted by measured consumption
- Equal: split evenly per namespace
- Weighted: by revenue, headcount, or custom weights
- None: baseline (no split, shows the unattributed total)

Outputs per-namespace result and a paste-ready report line.

## Key files

- cmd/ocost-splitter/main.go: CLI entry point (Go)
- internal/allocation/model.go: data models
- internal/split/split.go: split logic
- go.mod: module definition (Go 1.24)

## CLI usage

    ocost-splitter --input allocation.json --method proportional
    ocost-splitter --input allocation.json --method equal --report

## Flags

- --input: path to OpenCost allocation JSON
- --method: split method (proportional, equal, weighted, none)
- --weights: path to weights CSV (for weighted method)
- --report: one paste-ready summary line
- --json: machine-readable output

## Exit codes

- 0: success
- 1: error

## Design patterns

- Go 1.24, single static binary
- Zero runtime dependencies (stdlib only)
- MIT license
- CNCF contribution candidate (upstreamable to OpenCost)
- --report mode for paste-ready output
